recovery_contract.sack_loss_authority: Because the receiver advertises only four recent SACK ranges, absence from SACK is not proof for arbitrary non-head data. Initial SACK fast recovery is restricted to the cumulative-ACK boundary/oldest hole with at least three SACKed segments above it.
recovery_contract.rack_freshness: A retried cumulative oldest hole may be fast-repaired again only when rackLatestTx proves delivery of a transmission sent after that hole's latest LastSent and the reordering window has elapsed. markRetry refreshes LastSent, so evidence consumed for one repair becomes stale immediately. Replaying the same old ACK/SACK cannot self-trigger. There is no arbitrary Retries==1/two-repair ceiling when genuinely newer delivery evidence exists.
recovery_contract.rto_episode: Estimator-derived baseRTO is distinct from the current timeout episode's effective rto. Repeated timeouts of the same unresolved oldest segment still back off exponentially. Cumulative ACK coverage of the timed-out oldest segment ends that episode and restores effective rto to baseRTO without taking an ambiguous retransmission RTT sample. Partial/duplicate ACK and stale SACK evidence do not reset the episode.
recovery_contract.do_not_regress: Do not restore all-window/non-head loss inference, do not restore an arbitrary two-repair cap, do not reset timeout backoff on duplicate/partial progress, never raise the 4096 outstanding ceiling, never add an ARQ retry ceiling, never discard pending data to relieve pressure, and never free SACKed data before cumulative ACK.

fec_contract.wire_geometry: Fixed systematic Reed-Solomon 20:20; full block stays 20 source + 20 repair; partial streaming flush stays N source + N repair.
fec_contract.heavy_state: Product decoder heavy reconstruction window remains bounded at maxBlocks=64.
fec_contract.retired_state: Use the formal compact retired/tombstone container with hard maxRetiredBlocks=8192. Never use an unbounded degraded map.
fec_contract.pressure_policy: On pressure, safely degradable old streaming state may be retired compactly. If every heavy victim is unsafe, a new streaming block enters bounded ARQ-only retired state instead of permanently blocking forward progress. Unsafe reference/final state must not be evicted. Aged retired entries are folded into completed history so memory remains bounded and very-late shards cannot reopen them.
